With the moratorium defeated, the five town buildings can still be considered for sale, and any sale would come back as a separate decision.

what_happened.line: Town Meeting voted to pass over the article on the primary school, then passed over the Town Hall article, which a speaker tied to structural work.
Town Meeting took up the solar PILOT article, and the minutes do not record an audible outcome for that vote.
Selectmen assured that any pilot negotiation would include a first-priority window for Lunenburg residents.
Town Meeting passed over article 27, then took up sewer liens and tax collection articles, with no audible vote results in the minutes.
Town Meeting took up the marijuana moratorium and amended bylaw articles by counted votes, but the captions do not make the outcomes audible.
